Anticipate.description: By perceiving a foe's intentions telepathically, a mindspy can determine how to evade incoming strikes and identify gaps in that foe's defenses. Starting at 1st level, when a mindspy is actively reading a target's surface thoughts (after the standard 3-round process and a failed Will save by the target), she may apply 1 point of her Charisma bonus (if positive) per mindspy class level as an insight bonus to AC against that foe's attacks, and she also gains an equal insight bonus on attack rolls against any foe whose surface thoughts she is currently reading. This AC bonus is lost whenever the mindspy would be denied her Dexterity bonus, such as when caught flat-footed.

Combat Telepathy.description: A mindspy who is actively reading the surface thoughts of her opponents can track their intentions during battle. At the start of her turn, she may attempt a Concentration check (DC 10 + damage sustained in the preceding round). On a success, she sustains detect thoughts as a free action for that round. However, if she casts any spell or activates any other spell-like ability, the detect thoughts effect immediately ends.

Faster Mindscan.description: Starting at 2nd level, a mindspy processes telepathic information much more rapidly. On the first round after activating detect thoughts, she immediately senses whether thinking minds are present, how many there are, and the Intelligence score of each. On the following round, she can read the surface thoughts of one creature in the area.

Instant Mindscan.description: From 4th level onward, a mindspy can probe enemy minds with virtually no delay. In the very same round she activates detect thoughts, she receives all available information at once: the presence of thinking minds, their Intelligence scores, and their surface thoughts. Targets are still entitled to Will saves to shield their surface thoughts from being read.

Multiple Surface Thoughts.description: Beginning at 3rd level, a mindspy can read the surface thoughts of up to two creatures simultaneously (provided those creatures fail their Will saves), granting her the anticipate bonuses against each of them. As a free action once per round, she may switch to different target minds. At 5th level, the number of creatures whose thoughts she can monitor at once increases to four.

Spherical Detect Thoughts.description: A mindspy can reshape the area of her detect thoughts effect from its normal cone into a sphere centered on herself. The sphere's radius equals the cone's normal length.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.

classFeatures.description: Mindspies gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.
classFeatures.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency

classFeatures.description: Because she is reading her foe's thoughts, a mindspy knows where she needs to block and how she needs to dodge before an attack from the foe arrives. In addition, a mindspy can detect weak points in a foe's defense by observing her enemy's thoughts. At 1st level, a mindspy can add 1 point of Charisma bonus (if any) per mindspy class level as a bonus to her Armor Class against attacks from a foe whose surface thoughts she is detecting (if the normal 3 rounds passes and the target fails its Will save) as well as an insight bonus on attack rolls against any foe whose surface thoughts she is detecting. If a mindspy is caught flat-footed or is otherwise denied her Dexterity bonus, she also loses this insight bonus to her Armor Class.
classFeatures.name: Anticipate

classFeatures.description: By reading her opponents' surface thoughts, a mindspy can anticipate their every move. She can make a Concentration check (DC 10 + damage taken during the previous round) at the beginning of her turn. If the mindspy succeeds, she can maintain concentration on detect thoughts as a free action. If the mindspy casts a spell or uses another spell-like ability, detect thoughts ends.
classFeatures.name: Combat Telepathy

classFeatures.description: A mindspy can widen the area of her detect thoughts spell or ability into a sphere centered on her, rather than a cone. The radius of the sphere is equal to the length of the cone.
classFeatures.name: Spherical Detect Thoughts

classFeatures.description: By 2nd level, a mindspy has become adept at tuning into others' thoughts quickly. In the round when she activates detect thoughts, she detects the presence or absence of thoughts and the Intelligence score of each thinking mind in the area. In the next round, she detects the surface thoughts of any one mind in the area.
classFeatures.name: Faster Mindscan

classFeatures.description: A mindspy of 3rd level or higher can simultaneously detect the surface thoughts of any two creatures who fail their Will saves. This means that she gains anticipate bonuses against both of them. Once per round as a free action, she can choose new minds to listen in on. At 5th level, a mindspy can simultaneously detect the surface thoughts of four creatures.
classFeatures.name: Multiple Surface Thoughts

classFeatures.description: At 4th level and higher, a mindspy can enter her enemies' minds at the speed of thought. She gains all the information from detect thoughts (presence or absence of minds, Intelligence scores, and surface thoughts) in the same round when she activates the spell or ability. The mindspy's enemies still get Will saves to keep their surface thoughts secret.
classFeatures.name: Instant Mindscan

raw.description: By reading the minds of her enemies, a mindspy knows exactly what they're going to do a fraction of a second before they do it.
raw.name: Mindspy

special: Able to cast the detect thoughts spell or to use detect thoughts as a spell-like ability.
